AIDY's strategic destination is a full point-in-time Gold specialist, not merely a provider scorer. Build claim-grounded reasoning, a qualified Gold-state dossier, breaking-news/event intelligence, liquidity/execution intelligence, conditional provider alpha decomposition, regime-matched historical analogue memory, calibrated probability/expected-value decisions, profit-extraction management research, failure attribution/UNKNOWN handling, and continuous self-critique/ablation. Every provider-specific rationale claim must be addressable to exact PIT evidence; unsupported claims are forbidden. News is context rather than an automatic directional command. AIDY must explain abnormal Gold moves and trade failures when evidence supports a mechanism, and explicitly say UNKNOWN when it does not. The two-repo boundary remains hard: Aidy-Gold-Signals owns market/research intelligence, Super Signals owns provider/broker execution, and exchange happens only through versioned PIT-safe contracts. Live-money authority remains OFF until each decision class independently passes prospective counterfactual/calibration/adversarial gates and receives explicit owner approval.
reason: Owner explicitly wants AIDY to know why Gold moves, why trades fail, when liquidity matters, how to maximise winner extraction, how historical regimes match, and when each provider is conditionally strong; the live reasoning audit also proved unsupported provider-history claims must be technically impossible rather than merely discouraged.

decision: The 2026-09-22 independent adversarial audit of AIDY Builds 1-24 was itself independently verified by a second reviewer in a separate read-only run against the same SHA and live D1. Every headline number was confirmed, plus average directional_total = 0.004491 against the required 0.30. The RED classification of the decision layer stands. Four corrections are adopted: (1) reachability is 'practically unreachable', not 'mathematically impossible' — with perfect reliability across every directional gate the current formula can just exceed 0.30, ceiling 0.5137, so the original absolute phrasing is withdrawn; (2) scope fallback is 196 gate_global plus 50 neutral_prior selections among directional gates, not '100 percent gate_global' — zero contextual scopes ever qualify, so the substance is unchanged; (3) the H4/D1 backfill from existing M1 must preserve each source bar's original first_observed_at and PIT lineage, a condition the original audit omitted and without which retrospective evaluation would gain hindsight; (4) the remedy for gate-level abstain is NOT to give abstain a directional weight but to stop discarding directional sub-evidence — surface sub-calculator-level evidence or move gates to continuous/probabilistic output. The adopted aggregator redesign separates reliability, independence and decision strength, uses gate reliability into root-family aggregation into a normalised directional balance, and adds a separate evidence-sufficiency condition of at least two genuinely independent families with adequate trust and sample support.
reason: Two independent reviewers now agree that the 24-build concept was not disproven; what was disproven is the claim that the finished system was ready to make knowledgeable directional calls. The hard-to-repair properties — PIT discipline, revision safety, explainability, Build 19 retrieval, the gate contract, AIDY/Super Signals isolation and the prospective evidence trail — are sound. What failed is integration mathematics and live plumbing. Recording the corrections matters because the original audit's absolute phrasing and its unqualified backfill recommendation could each have caused a downstream error: the first by overstating what was proven, the second by injecting hindsight into retrospective evaluation.
